text:
alice: Planning the nightly feature-flag flip for model-routing. Proposal: staggered ramp at 22:00 UTC — cohorts 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%, 15m soak per step, 2h total window. Pin new version v2.3.1 for the cohort.

bob: sounds reasonable. what are our rollback thresholds?

carla: want to keep an eye on quality regressions (BLEU/semantic score) + error rate. suggest rollback if 3xx/4xx spike > 0.5% over baseline or latency p95 increase > 200ms.

ryan: agree. add circuit-breaker at 50% step: if any user-facing errors > 0.3% for 5m, auto-drain back to previous model.

alice: noted. I'll add to the runbook. Also thinking we should snooze noisy infra alerting for the first 30m of the rollout to avoid pager storms. @bob ok to mute alert:route-latency for 30m?

bob: can do but will keep on-call watching. I'll set a temporary mute and a pinned watch message.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by alice at 2026-03-22T22:00:00Z. Actions to run: 
- create cohort release (5%) pinned to v2.3.1
- run canary traffic tests
- escalate according to thresholds

alice: commands we'll use (for records):
```
/ff release set model-route --version v2.3.1 --cohort 5% --soak 15m
/ff release bump model-route --cohort 25% --soak 15m
/ff release bump model-route --cohort 50% --soak 15m --circuit 0.3%
/ff release finalize model-route --cohort 100%
```

carla: can we add a short rollback play: if we hit threshold, revert cohort to pinned v2.2.9 and drain new sessions?

alice: yes. rollback command: `/ff release revert model-route --target-version v2.2.9 --drain=true` 

bob: I'll also create a quick telemetry dashboard and annotate the time windows. Tagging page with: `#ff-nightly-6523456789` so SRE can follow.

ryan: question on capacity — do we need reserved Dedicated burst for the 50->100% shift?

alice: yep, already requested an autoscale bump for the reserved pool from 8 -> 12 GPUs starting 21:50 UTC to give headroom. 

deploy-bot: Autoscale request accepted. Reserved pool change scheduled at 2026-03-22T21:50:00Z.

carla: final check: release notes updated and product signoff done. I'm going to be available during the window.

alice: thanks. I'll trigger a preflight run at 21:40 UTC and post the quick checklist. If anyone sees a bad signal, call out here and deploy-bot will pause the rollout. :thumbsup:

bob: mute applied to alert:route-latency for 30m, watch channel set. Oncall standing by.

deploy-bot: Reminder: to pause during rollout use `/ff release pause model-route` and to resume use `/ff release resume model-route`. Logs will be captured to /deploys/model-route/6523456789.

alice: locking final: start 22:00 UTC, rollout plan as above. Good luck team.
